recordings.title: FOG Japan invites Yoichiro Kawakami
recordings.description:
Forbidden Hawaiian Sound Service is a DJ and selector blending sounds from around the world into atmospheric sets spanning balearic,ambient,jazz,and dance music. While he was touring Europe we had the honour and the pleasure to have him recording a precious ambient set as an addendum to our pilot first FOG episode. 

@forbiddenhawaii

recordings.title: FOG Korea invites Recy
recordings.description:
Recy, based in Seoul, seamlessly weaves percussive elements with expansive, nature-inspired soundscapes. As a producer and DJ active in Korea’s underground scene, he crafts immersive experiences, translating raw, stimulating textures into a primal language for the dancefloor. With releases on highly respected labels, he continues to push the boundaries of his sonic identity.
